        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, on or about an individual's person or accessible property.",

        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F002", "F003", "F004"],
        "choice_quote": "F002:F004",
        "choice_text": "(1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",

        "references": ["paragraph (b)", "§ 1544.201", "§ 1546.201", "§ 1562.23"],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005:F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F005"],
        "scope_text": "As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F006", "F007", "F008"],
        "choice_quote": "F006:F008",
        "choice_text": "If the individual is one of the following: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "logic_quote": "F005:F008",
        "references": ["Paragraph (a)", "§ 1544.219", "§ 1544.221", "§ 1544.223", "§ 1546.211", "subpart B of part 1562"],
        "statement": "Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of 49 CFR chapter XII; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F016",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["F009"],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [],

        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F010", "F011:F015", "F016"],
        "choice_quote": "F010:F016",
        "choice_text": "(1) Any loaded firearm(s); (2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, (ii) the firearm is unloaded, (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination; or (3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.",
        "logic_quote": "F011:F015",
        "references": ["§ 1562.23"],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of 49 CFR chapter XII: (1) any loaded firearm(s); (2) any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container in which it is carried is locked and only the passenger retains the key or combination; or (3) any unauthorized explosive or incendiary."
      }

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, on or about an individual's person or accessible property.
unit_attributes.choice_text: (1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property.
unit_attributes.choice_text: If the individual is one of the following: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of 49 CFR chapter XII; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: (1) Any loaded firearm(s); (2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, (ii) the firearm is unloaded, (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination; or (3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of 49 CFR chapter XII: (1) any loaded firearm(s); (2) any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container in which it is carried is locked and only the passenger retains the key or combination; or (3) any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
